tools.name: get_auto_tuning_type
tools.description: Check which auto tuning feature is currently active on a specific GPU. Use this when you need to know the current auto tuning type, or when the user asks about current auto tuning settings. Returns 'Undervolt GPU', 'Overclock GPU', 'Overclock VRAM', or 'None' if no auto tuning is active.

tools.name: start_auto_tuning
tools.description: Start GPU auto tuning to optimize performance. Use this when the user wants to enable auto tuning, improve GPU performance, start overclocking or undervolting. This will automatically find optimal settings for the specified tuning type. Choose 'undervolt_gpu' to reduce power consumption while maintaining performance, 'overclock_gpu' to boost GPU core performance, or 'overclock_vram' to increase memory bandwidth.

tools.name: get_manual_fan_tuning_range
tools.description: Get the allowable range for specific fan tuning settings. Use this to understand the limits before setting values, or when the user asks about fan tuning capabilities. Supports 'fan_tuning' (speed/temperature ranges), 'min_acoustic_limit', 'min_fan_speed', and 'target_fan_speed' settings.

setting.description: The fan setting to get range information for

tools.name: get_manual_fan_tuning_state
tools.description: Get current values for specific fan tuning settings. Use this to check current fan configuration, monitor fan behavior, or when the user asks about current fan settings. Returns detailed information including fan curves, RPM states, acoustic limits, and speed targets.

setting.description: The fan setting to get current state for

tools.name: set_manual_fan_tuning_state

value.description: The value to set. For 'fan_tuning': dict with state indices as keys and [fan_speed, temperature] arrays as values. For 'zero_rpm': boolean. For other settings: integer. Use null to set default value.

oneOf.description: For fan_tuning: dictionary with state indices as keys and [fan_speed, temperature] arrays as values
For numeric settings like min_acoustic_limit, min_fan_speed, target_fan_speed
Use null to reset to default value

tools.name: get_manual_graphics_tuning_range
tools.description: Get the range of a specific manual graphics tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to understand the valid limits before setting values, or when the user asks about graphics tuning capabilities. Supports 'gpu_tuning' (pre-RDNA frequency/voltage ranges), 'min_frequency', 'max_frequency', and 'voltage' (post-RDNA ranges).

setting.description: The setting to get the range for

tools.name: get_manual_graphics_tuning_state
tools.description: Get the current state of a specific manual graphics tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to check current GPU frequency, voltage, or tuning states, or when the user asks about current graphics settings. Supports 'gpu_tuning' (pre-RDNA current states), 'min_frequency', 'max_frequency', and 'voltage' (post-RDNA current values).

setting.description: The setting to get the state for

tools.name: set_manual_graphics_tuning_state
tools.description: Set the state of a specific manual graphics tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to manually tune GPU performance by adjusting frequency, voltage, or tuning states. For 'gpu_tuning', provide a dictionary with state indices and (frequency, voltage) tuples. For other settings, provide integer values. Set value to null to reset to defaults.

anyOf.description: For 'gpu_tuning': Dictionary with state indices as keys and [frequency, voltage] arrays as values
For frequency settings: value in MHz. For voltage: value in mV
Set to null to reset to default values

tools.name: get_manual_power_tuning_range
tools.description: Get the range of a specific manual power tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to understand the valid limits before setting values, or when the user asks about power tuning capabilities. Supports 'power_limit' and 'tdc_limit' settings.

setting.description: The setting to get the range for

tools.name: get_manual_power_tuning_state
tools.description: Get the current state of a specific manual power tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to check current power limits or TDC settings, or when the user asks about current power configurations. Supports 'power_limit' and 'tdc_limit' settings.

setting.description: The setting to get the state for

tools.name: set_manual_power_tuning_state
tools.description: Set the state of a specific manual power tuning setting for a GPU. Use this to manually tune GPU power consumption by adjusting power limits or TDC limits. For 'power_limit', provide percentage values. For 'tdc_limit', provide values in Amperes. Set value to null to reset to defaults.

anyOf.description: For 'power_limit': percentage value. For 'tdc_limit': value in Amperes
Set to null to reset to default values

tools.name: get_supported_memory_timing_description_list
tools.description: Get the list of supported memory timing descriptions for a GPU

tools.name: get_memory_timing_description
tools.description: Get the current memory timing description for a GPU

tools.name: set_memory_timing_description
tools.description: Set the memory timing description for a GPU

description.description: Memory timing description to set, available options: ["MEMORYTIMING_AUTOMATIC", "MEMORYTIMING_DEFAULT", "MEMORYTIMING_FAST_TIMING", "MEMORYTIMING_FAST_TIMING_LEVEL_2", "MEMORYTIMING_MEMORYTIMING_LEVEL_1", "MEMORYTIMING_MEMORYTIMING_LEVEL_2"

tools.name: get_vram_tuning_ranges
tools.description: Get the VRAM tuning ranges (frequency and voltage) for a GPU using Interface 1

tools.name: get_vram_tuning_states
tools.description: Get the current VRAM tuning states for a GPU using Interface 1

state_index.description: Index of the state to retrieve (-1 for all states)

tools.name: set_vram_tuning_states
tools.description: Set the VRAM tuning states for a GPU using Interface 1

states.description: Dictionary with state indices as keys and (frequency, voltage) tuples as values

tools.name: get_max_vram_frequency_range
tools.description: Get the maximum VRAM frequency range for a GPU using Interface 2

tools.name: get_max_vram_frequency
tools.description: Get the current maximum VRAM frequency using Interface 2

tools.name: set_max_vram_frequency
tools.description: Set the maximum VRAM frequency using Interface 2

tools.name: get_preset_tuning_mode
tools.description: Get the preset tuning mode for a GPU. Use this to check if a specific preset mode is currently active.

mode.description: Preset mode to check ('Quiet' (Favor Efficiency), 'Balanced', 'Rage' (Favor Performance)), if None, returns all modes

tools.name: set_preset_tuning_mode
tools.description: Set the preset tuning mode for a GPU. Use this to apply a specific preset configuration. The Quiet mode favors efficiency, while the Rage mode favors performance.

tools.name: is_gpu_tuning_default
tools.description: Check if GPU tuning settings are at factory defaults for a specific GPU. Use this to verify if any GPU tuning settings (auto, graphics, VRAM, fan, power, preset) are currently at their original factory values or default status. This is useful for determining if any custom tuning has been applied to the GPU.

tools.name: reset_gpu_tuning
tools.description: Reset any GPU tuning settings to factory defaults for a specific GPU. Use this to restore any GPU tuning settings (auto, graphics, VRAM, fan, power, preset) to their original factory values. This will undo any custom tuning that has been applied to the GPU.
